rationale: Prospect Lake Clean Water Center is one Fort Lauderdale water-P3 project company, legally Prospect Lake Water, L.P. The census Ridgewood holding is the existing ownership period, not a duplicate. Municipal records and Ridgewood's April 2026 interview directly support IDE Technologies as the other equity owner. The status should be corrected from operating to commissioning/pre-COD as of the cutoff. Application remains blocked until the July 31, 2026 LP amendment is inspected and shown not to change ownership or the general-partner structure.
recommendedChanges: Keep one canonical Prospect Lake Clean Water Center record mapped to Prospect Lake Water, L.P.
Retain and enrich the existing Ridgewood Infrastructure/Fund II period beginning February 14, 2023; do not add a duplicate Ridgewood row.
Add IDE Technologies through IDE PLCWC, Inc. as a separate active equity owner from February 14, 2023 without inventing the sponsor split.
Correct the selection milestone to March 1, 2022 and the cutoff status to commissioning/pre-COD.
Keep the City, Kiewit, PLCWC O&M, Fiveash and project components out of direct-owner and separate-PortCo treatment.
unresolvedQuestions: The exact Ridgewood and IDE percentage stakes are not publicly disclosed.
The July 31, 2026 Prospect Lake Water, L.P. amendment has not yet been inspected for a possible ownership or general-partner change.
Final commissioning and commercial-operation acceptance had not occurred by the August 19, 2026 cutoff.
fieldCorrections: Treat IDE as both equity owner and operating-technology partner, not merely a contractor.
Do not infer equal Ridgewood/IDE stakes from the joint 25-percent project-team capital contribution.
Do not describe the project as operating before commissioning and acceptance.
